primitives.meaning: a defined intervention actually delivered: a plan alternative, a pause option, a support resolution, human outreach, or an approved save offer
entryFilters: a defined intervention actually delivered: a plan alternative, a pause option, a support resolution, human outreach, or an approved save offer
no instance of this journey is already open for the the customer
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

cancelOn.meaning: the person accepts the retention alternative offered
the person explicitly declines the retention alternative
the relationship's own state recovers without the person answering the offer
the intervention could not be executed

primitives.reads: the the customer re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

branches.label: Accepted
branches.test: the customer took what was offered

branches.label: Declined
branches.test: the customer explicitly turned it down

branches.label: Recovered without answering
branches.test: the relationship improved but nobody responded to the offer itself

branches.label: Failed to execute
branches.test: the intervention was accepted or attempted and did not actually apply

primitives.does: Verify against the system of record that the relationship actually changed - the plan changed, the pause is active, the issue is closed, the subscription is retained. Acceptance is a customer saying yes; application is the state having moved, and the gap between them is where retention numbers go wrong

branches.label: Applied
branches.test: the authoritative record shows the change

branches.label: Accepted but not applied
branches.test: the customer agreed and the change did not take effect

primitives.on: a retention outcome that looks positive
carries: what was accepted and what actually changed
the fact that this is one positive event, which is why it goes to observation rather than to a recovered state

primitives.on: an intervention that did not apply
carries: what was agreed and what failed to happen
the explicit fact that retention has not succeeded, however the customer answered
suppresses: any recording of this as a retained relationship until the change actually applies

primitives.does: Record the decline against this cancellation episode, so the same offer is not made again inside it. Repeating a declined offer is the behaviour that makes a save attempt read as an obstacle

primitives.asks: Is a cancellation still in progress?

branches.label: Still cancelling
branches.test: the customer declined and is continuing to leave

branches.label: No cancellation underway
branches.test: the offer was declined but nothing is being cancelled

primitives.on: a declined save offer with cancellation continuing
carries: the declared reason it was chosen against

primitives.reEntry: a new episode with new evidence may justify a different intervention; the declined one is not re-sent inside this episode

primitives.asks: With no response, is one bounded follow-up justified?

branches.label: Justified
branches.test: the offer is time-limited or its terms were plausibly not understood

branches.label: Not justified
branches.test: silence is a clear enough answer and repeating it adds only pressure

competition.precedence: lowest in the group - any live risk case or open issue on the same account outranks it

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it
the person is active in the product and the action is taken there

primitives.brief: Send one follow-up and stop. There is no second, whatever the value of the relationship
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.state: no response; episode closed, cooldown in force
primitives.reEntry: a new episode may open on new evidence, and this intervention is not repeated within the cooldown
